protocol.name: league-factor-search-v1
protocol.audit_status: Already viewed seasons; descriptive reanalysis only
protocol.goal90: Target only. At least 200 scored distinct fixtures and match-cluster bootstrap lower bound above 90% for descriptive evidence; no independent claim on viewed data.

limitations: League-local coefficients, local/global blend and shrinkage selected only on earlier development outcomes.
If local training <200 fixtures, local predictions fall back to pooled; if development <200, league selection stays pooled.
Viewed audit periods cannot certify future 90% accuracy, regardless of number of repeated trials.
Probability filters select subsets; report hits, misses, unscored, unique fixtures and coverage.
Coach and direct player-pair features still unavailable; not used or inferred from club results.
Lineups, odds, tactical events and injury data absent. Calendar-date schedule is a retrospective snapshot.
Match-cluster interval handles offers sharing a fixture, but not all temporal/league dependence or model-selection uncertainty.
720 new group-ablation comparisons plus 260 reused prior comparisons; not 980 new independent tests.
without_current_elo removes the current rating difference but retains opponent-history ratings in the context group.
Full context adds venue, previous-opponent strength, form and recorded league fixture gaps; it does not add actual tactics or personnel data.
